name: 网上国网
description: fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
text:
#!name=网上国网
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = osg-static.sgcc.com.cn, osg-service.sgcc.com.cn

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/(?>csc|osg)-service\.sgcc\.com\.cn:\d+\/emss-pfa-appset-front\/appForceUpdate/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/(?>csc|osg)-service\.sgcc\.com\.cn:\d+\/emss-pfa-appset-front\/appSync\/getAppForceUpgrade/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/(?>csc|osg)-service\.sgcc\.com\.cn:\d+\/emss-pfa-appset-front\/bootpageoutter\//i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/(?>csc|osg)-service\.sgcc\.com\.cn:\d+\/.*\/app_api\/selectInfoByCondition/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/(?>csc|osg)-service\.sgcc\.com\.cn:\d+\/.*\/inner\/cache/i then reject(404)
